Status: confirmed = same price read today; changed = different price read today; unavailable = offering absent from the reference page; not_rechecked = attempted but no readable/attributable USD price today (price untouched). Lambda pages redirect to lambda.com, which this run could not fetch. Per-node prices divided by GPUs per node as noted.
